name: Almond Flour
siboNotes: Well-tolerated by most SIBO patients as it's naturally grain-free and low in fermentable carbohydrates. High fat content may slow gastric emptying in some individuals.
preparationTips: Store in refrigerator or freezer to prevent rancidity due to high oil content
Sift before using to remove any large pieces and ensure smooth texture
Use blanched almond flour for lighter colored baked goods
Substitute up to 25% of regular flour in recipes to start
alternatives: Coconut flour (use less, it's more absorbent)
nutritionalHighlights: High in protein and healthy monounsaturated fats
Good source of vitamin E and magnesium
Lower in carbohydrates than wheat flour
